verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is a card-issuing API/platform, not an AI agent or agent host that itself consumes external tools via MCP; the only MCP-related evidence shows Stripe exposing an MCP *server* for other agents to call Stripe's API (docs-16, probe-4), which is the opposite role from what this story asks (the product acting as an MCP client plugging into other servers). This axis is a category error for this kind of product.
